claim: Under the assumptions of local existence, the relativistic and classical solutions satisfy uniform bounds on velocity, temperature, and number density that are independent of the speed of light c.
falsifier: One can numerically solve both systems and check that the solutions stay within the bounds independent of c.

conditions: local existence of both solutions on [0,T]
initial data sufficiently close to constant states
exclusions: limited to the regime where both relativistic and classical Euler equations have local classical solutions and the initial data are small perturbations of constant states

title: Initial data in–uniform bounds on u principle
